title: Crunchy Lime Tarts
description: A sweet and tangy dessert made with a crunchy lime crust and a dollop of whipped cream.
instructions: Make the crust by mixing together the crunchy and sugar in a bowl.
Press the crust mixture into a tart pan.
Bake the crust for 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden.
While the crust is baking, mix together the lime zest, lime juice, and eggs in a bowl.
Pour the lime mixture into the baked tart crust.
Bake for an additional 20-25 minutes or until the filling is set.
Let the tarts cool completely before serving.
Top with whipped cream before serving.
